title: KU aerospace engineering student wins first place in international aircraft design competition
summary_en: The win marks the KU aerospace engineering department’s 109th award in American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics competitions dating back 50 years.
title_cn: KU aerospace engineering student wins first place in international aircraft design competition

title: KU eating disorders research center to welcome the public with open house and resource fair
summary_en: The Center for the Advancement of Research on Eating Behaviors at the Life Span Institute recently moved to Youngberg Hall on the University of Kansas campus in Lawrence.
